description: This file defines the OpenDialogCommand class, which implements AJAX commands for opening dialogs in Drupal. It includes methods for constructing dialog commands, setting options, and rendering the command as an array.

classes.name: OpenDialogCommand
classes.description: A class implementing an AJAX command to open a dialog with configurable options and content in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an OpenDialogCommand object with specified selector, title, content, dialog options, and settings.

methods.name: setDialogOption
methods.description: Sets a single dialog option value.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the AJAX command as an array for execution.
